overall_assessment: USN extraction is good: all 28 plans hold the full plan text for the right course code and year, the 'Page text not in extracted text' is empty everywhere, and no wrong-page, wrong-year or empty cases appear. The 3 suspects are false alarms (genuinely sparse or long plans). Remaining problems are low severity: a table-of-contents block, Leganto widget artefacts, per-campus reading-list repeats, a mis-encoded character, and one URL whose code differs from the course.

findings.description: Every plan has a table-of-contents block ('Innholdsfortegnelse' or 'Table of contents' followed by the list of section headings, including 'Emnet inngår i følgende studier') before the real content. It is navigation, not plan text, and repeats every heading. In sparse plans (HMT5900-1, EE505-1) it is most of the text. Also the final heading 'Emnet inngår i følgende studier' is often left with no content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: shadow_dom strategy takes the whole plan component text, including the TOC element.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop the block from the 'Innholdsfortegnelse' / 'Table of contents' line up to the next heading that repeats its first entry, in the usn post_fn, or exclude the TOC element in the shadow DOM extraction.

findings.evidence: Click to view interactive reading list in LegantoObligatorisk litteratur
findings.description: Leganto reading lists are glued: the widget label runs into the next heading ('LegantoObligatorisk litteratur'), and item type labels run into titles ('BookVarehandelsledelse', 'ArticleThe Beginning of the Viking Age in the West'). Widget text ('Click to view interactive reading list in Leganto', 'View online', 'In compendium') is UI boilerplate.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The Leganto web component renders inline spans without separators, so text extraction concatenates them.
findings.suggested_fix: Insert a newline after 'Leganto' and after the known type labels (Book, Book Chapter, Article, E-book, Journal, Website, Document, Note), and drop the 'Click to view interactive reading list in Leganto', 'View online' and 'In compendium' lines.

findings.description: For courses taught on several campuses the Litteratur section contains one reading list per campus, each repeating the same references (MET1020: Bø, Drammen, Kongsberg, Ringerike, Vestfold, Bø again, then the lists again). The same block appears several times and list titles are not literature, which inflates the reading list and counts of repeated references.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The page renders one Leganto list per campus plus a header with all list names; all are captured.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop the campus list-name lines that precede 'Click to view', and deduplicate repeated reference blocks within the reading_list section (or keep only the first list).

findings.evidence: Å leve med langvarig smerte ¿ konsekvenser
findings.description: Dashes and apostrophes are mis-encoded as the character '¿' (also 'students¿ part', 'oppgave¿ og organisasjonsperspektivet'). Characters are lost in the source (likely legacy-encoded data in the plan) and could harm text analysis.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Encoding loss in the source system for older plans; not a selector issue.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a post_fn replacement for '¿' used between spaces as an en-dash and as an apostrophe after a word (' ¿ ' to ' - ', 'x¿ ' to "x' "), or document it as a source defect.

findings.description: The offering is BABLU-6 (Bacheloroppgave i barnehagelærerutdanning) but the URL asks for BABLU_3 and the plan's code reads 'BABLU' with no number. The page may be a sibling or the wrong BABLU variant; the plan matches the title but the code mapping is not reliable, so it may be shared across several offerings.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: URL builder in R/add_course_url.R derives the code part from the course code and a different suffix for this course (the number after the dash is not the one in the id).
findings.suggested_fix: Check how R/add_course_url.R builds the code for ids ending in -N with N other than 1, and verify that BABLU_3 and BABLU_6 are not both mapped to the same page; add a test with BABLU.

findings.evidence: Med forbehold om at emnet ikke går høsten 2025.
findings.description: The plan for EE505 states that the course is not given in autumn 2025, with no content (literature not published). The offering is likely not run; the text holds almost no plan content. Pre-pass flag 'short' is a real but correct signal, not an extraction error. The same applies to HMT5900-1 (empty body, only headings and 'Pensum-/litteraturliste er ikke publisert ennå.').
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Source plan is a placeholder; extraction is faithful.
findings.suggested_fix: No extraction change; consider flagging plans with no sections beyond the TOC and facts box downstream so they are not counted as full plans.
